items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(f) covers the first travel charge on the contractor's invoice: 1 × €81.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers like-for-like sealing material used in the pipe repair: 1 × €26.
The failed indoor supply pipe is covered under §2.4.3(a), and §7.1.7(c) allows like-for-like repair material: 1 m × €40.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstating the insulation on the repaired pipe: 1 m × €23.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary plumbing labour. This is billed as one hour, so the comparable plumbing installer rate applies at 1 × €90, not the flat rate for installing an air-conditioning unit.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers the technician's pipe-repair labour, with no duplicate technician charge shown. The 9 invoiced units at €95 give €855.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary drying and one equipment deployment charge per drying operation: 1 × €548.

items.description: Close and repaint the wall patch
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a) cover closing the access opening and restoring the disturbed patch: 1 × €588.

items.description: Full repaint of the affected wall
items.rationale: The patch is already covered by line 8, and §7.1.6 does not extend cover to the unaffected remainder because matching paint was still available. The conditional estimate is 8 m² × €25.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.6 exclude repainting separate, undamaged surfaces for a colour match. The conditional estimate is 1 flat rate × €600.
